agent: ccountry-signatures: the nineteen CCountry methods project.json named but never signed
question: Give a signature - return type, calling convention and parameters, read off the ret and the call sites - to the nineteen CCountry methods project.json records with no signature at all, so the receiver is typed and field accesses through it stop decompiling as offsets into nothing.

addresses.name: CCountry::GetCapitalLocation
addresses.comment:
The capital's province: the game state's province vector (+0xB8C) indexed by CCountry +0xE20. Byte for byte the same function as GetActingCapitalLocation (0x2F100) but for the offset it reads, which is what settles which field is which.

**Signature**: `this` in ecx and nothing on the stack - a bare `ret`, and the 55 call sites push nothing.
addresses.revises: wave 3: the entry carried no signature at all, so CCountry::GetCapitalLocation decompiled with an untyped receiver and every field access through it became an offset into nothing. Nothing else about the entry changes - the rva, the name, the kind and the confidence are as recorded, and the comment is the recorded one with a sentence added for the signature.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py rva:0x17AF0 (VA 0x417AF0): the only receiver is ecx - `mov edi, ecx` at 0x417B16 - and the country field it reads comes off edi, `mov eax, [edi+0xE20]` at 0x417B84, which project.json already names capital_province_id. That index is taken from the game state's province vector, `mov ecx, [esi+0xB8C]` at 0x417B7E, recorded as CCurrentGameState.provinces_begin of type CMapProvince**, so the eax it leaves is a CMapProvince*. No ebp+ displacement above the frame pointer is read anywhere in the body, and cfg.walk finds exactly one return, a bare `ret` at 0x417B9D - no stack argument and nothing for the callee to clean. Call site 0x418E8E is `mov ecx, edi; call 0x417AF0` with no push, the same shape at all 55 of them. What would show it wrong: a `ret N` with N non-zero (checkSignatures reads it directly), any read of [ebp+8] in the body, or CCurrentGameState +0xB8C turning out to hold something other than CMapProvince*, which would change only the return type.

addresses.comment:
The game's capital province lookup; reads CCountry +0xE24.

**Signature**: `this` in ecx and nothing on the stack - a bare `ret`.

Nothing else about the entry changes - the rva, the name, the kind and the confidence are as recorded, and the comment is the recorded one with a sentence added for the signature. addresses.name: CCountry::GetBuildCost
addresses.signature: CFixedPoint* __thiscall CCountry::GetBuildCost(CCountry* this, CFixedPoint* out, CBuilding* building)
addresses.comment:
What this country pays for a building: the building's own cost (CBuilding +0x58) scaled by the discount its technology category earns, cost x (1000 - discount) / 1000. The slot 2 call on the category that guards it is the folded `mov al,1; ret` at 0xA92590, true for a real category and for the nocategory object alike, so the discount is always applied. That matters for a building whose category is nocategory - its index is 0, where every country's ability is 0, and an ability below 5.000 raises the cost: A building whose category is nocategory therefore costs about half as much again.

**Signature**: out is the hidden first stack argument and comes back in eax; `this` is in ecx, which is why the `ret` is 8 and not 12.
addresses.revises: wave 3: the entry carried no signature at all, so CCountry::GetBuildCost decompiled with an untyped receiver and every field access through it became an offset into nothing. Nothing else about the entry changes - the rva, the name, the kind and the confidence are as recorded, and the comment is the recorded one with a sentence added for the signature.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py rva:0xDFDA0 (VA 0x4DFDA0): `mov ebx, ecx` at 0x4DFDAC keeps the receiver, and ebx is then pushed as GetCategoryBuildDiscount's `country@stack:4` at 0x4DFDCC - that entry's signature is already established, so the receiver is a CCountry. [ebp+0xC] is read at 0x4DFDA6 and dereferenced at +0x58 and +0x88, which project.json names CBuilding.cost and CBuilding.technology_category_ptr, and +0x88 is pushed as that same call's `category@stack:8`. [ebp+8] is the hidden out pointer: `mov edi, [ebp+8]` at 0x4DFDB7, every result stored as `mov [edi], ...`, and `mov eax, edi` at 0x4DFDF2 returns it. cfg.walk: one `ret 8` - the two stack arguments. The sole call site, 0x7F29C9, pushes the building (from [ebx+0x140]) then a `lea` of a local as out, and loads ecx from its own frame. What would show it wrong: a third ebp+ read in the body, or CBuilding +0x58/+0x88 not being the fields project.json says they are - both offsets would have to be wrong together.

addresses.name: CCountry::GetAllowedResearchSlots
addresses.comment:
round(base_percentage x factor x TotalLeadership) - the research slider (LeadershipDistribution->Research, the fourth of the four) times the country's total leadership. Reads the two as fpml::fixed_point<__int64,48,15>, so the shifts by 15 and 30 and the 0x1F40000 are only the fixed point arithmetic.

addresses.comment:
[this+0x5E4][i] - the leadership slider at that index: 0 officers, 1 diplomacy, 2 espionage, 3 research, the order of the game's LeadershipCategory enum.

addresses.evidence: disasm.py rva:0xE06C0 (VA 0x4E06C0): five instructions - `mov eax, [ecx+0x5E4]`, `mov ecx, [ebp+8]`, `mov eax, [eax+ecx*4]`, `ret 4`. addresses.name: CCountry::GetBuildCostIC
addresses.signature: CFixedPoint* __thiscall CCountry::GetBuildCostIC(CCountry* this, CFixedPoint* out, CSubUnitDefinition* definition, int technologyBonus, bool reserves)
addresses.comment:
What a unit type costs this country. base is the definition's BuildCostIC (+0xF8); the multiplier is 1000, plus CTechnologyStatus +0x24C for the type, plus the third argument times 10 (so 1% a point), less the discount the definition's technology category (+0x3C) earns - the same 0xE1AC0 buildings use. Then, where the fourth argument is set, times (1000 + the country's RESERVES_PENALTY_SIZE modifier, 77) over 1000. The third argument is the caller's: the game works it out at 0x63D40 by adding up CTechnologyStatus +0x218 over the definition's own technology list (+0x44..+0x48). Only Lua calls this entry point; the game's own path is GetTotalBuildCost (0x63D40), which works the same cost out inline without the reserves step and multiplies it by GetBuildTime.

**Signature**: four stack arguments (`ret 0x10`) with out hidden first and returned in eax; the flag at [ebp+0x14] is tested as a byte, so it is a bool.
addresses.revises: wave 3: the entry carried no signature at all, so CCountry::GetBuildCostIC decompiled with an untyped receiver and every field access through it became an offset into nothing. Nothing else about the entry changes - the rva, the name, the kind and the confidence are as recorded, and the comment is the recorded one with a sentence added for the signature.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py rva:0xE18F0 (VA 0x4E18F0): four stack slots are read - [ebp+8] the out pointer (`mov edi, [ebp+8]`, every store `mov [edi], ...`, `mov eax, edi` at 0x4E1990), [ebp+0xC] the definition (+0xF8 build cost, +0x24 type_index, +0x3C technology_category_ptr, all named on CSubUnitDefinition, and +0x3C is pushed to GetCategoryBuildDiscount), [ebp+0x10] a scalar (`imul eax, eax, 0x3E8`), and [ebp+0x14] tested as a byte, `cmp byte ptr [ebp+0x14], 0` at 0x4E1961. The receiver is ecx: it is saved to [ebp-4] and pushed as GetCategoryBuildDiscount's `country@stack:4`, and [ecx+0xDF8] is the CTechnologyStatus the +0x24C table comes from. cfg.walk: one `ret 0x10` = four promoted stack slots. Call site 0x41AC41..0x41AC4B pushes them in reverse - the flag, the bonus, the definition, then a `lea` of a local as out - with `mov ecx, esi` last. What would show it wrong: a `ret` other than 16, or [ebp+0x14] being read as a full dword somewhere, which would make the last parameter an int rather than a bool - that would not change the arithmetic or the `ret`.

addresses.name: CCountry::GetBuildTime
addresses.signature: int __thiscall CCountry::GetBuildTime(CCountry* this, CSubUnitDefinition* definition, int technologyBonus)
addresses.comment:
How long a unit type takes this country to build. The definition's BuildTime (+0x100) times two factors over a million. The first is 1000, plus CTechnologyStatus +0x26C for the type, plus the second argument times 10, plus the country's UNIT_RECRUITMENT_TIME modifier (51), less the discount the definition's technology category earns (0xE1AC0, the same one the costs use); it is floored at 50. The second is 1000 plus one build speed modifier, chosen by the definition's kind flags in this order: is_rocket (+0x33) ROCKET_BUILD_SPEED, is_tank (+0x34) TANK_BUILD_SPEED, is_air (+0x2C) AIR_BUILD_SPEED, is_ship (+0x2E) NAVAL_BUILD_SPEED, else LAND_BUILD_SPEED.

**Signature**: unlike the costs this one answers a plain int in eax - divided by 1000 at 0x4E1AA5, and the callers multiply it back up - so there is no hidden out pointer and the `ret` is 8, not 12.
addresses.revises: wave 3: the entry carried no signature at all, so CCountry::GetBuildTime decompiled with an untyped receiver and every field access through it became an offset into nothing. Nothing else about the entry changes - the rva, the name, the kind and the confidence are as recorded, and the comment is the recorded one with a sentence added for the signature.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py rva:0xE19A0 (VA 0x4E19A0): `mov ebx, [ebp+8]` at 0x4E19A7 and ebx is the definition - +0x100 build time, +0x24 type_index, and the kind flags +0x33 is_rocket, +0x34 is_tank, +0x2C is_air, +0x2E is_ship, six offsets project.json already names on CSubUnitDefinition, which is more than coincidence carries. [ebp+0xC] is a scalar (`imul eax, eax, 0x3E8`). The receiver is ecx (`mov edi, ecx`), giving [edi+0xDF8] the technology status and [edi+0xDA8] the modifier block, and edi is pushed as GetCategoryBuildDiscount's country. There is no hidden out pointer: the tail divides by 1000 (`imul 0x10624DD3; sar edx, 6`) and leaves the result in eax, and caller 0x4855BB immediately does `imul eax, eax, 0x3E8` on it - a pointer would not survive that. cfg.walk: one `ret 8`. Call site 0x463D7E pushes the bonus then the definition with `mov ecx, esi`; 0x41AC2A does the same. What would show it wrong: a `ret` other than 8, or a caller reading [eax] after the call, which would mean eax was a pointer after all.

addresses.name: CCountry::RebuildNeighbours
addresses.comment:
Fills a country's two neighbour sets and the two CCountryList they stand for. It clears both, walks OwnedProvinces marking the owner of every adjacent province that nobody is occupying, then walks ControlledProvinces marking the controller of every adjacent province owned by somebody else. It is what says which set means what.

**Signature**: __stdcall, not __thiscall - the country is [ebp+8], ecx is never read, and the single `ret 4` is the callee cleaning it.
addresses.revises: wave 3: the entry carried no signature at all, so CCountry::RebuildNeighbours decompiled with an untyped receiver and every field access through it became an offset into nothing. Nothing else about the entry changes - the rva, the name, the kind and the confidence are as recorded, and the comment is the recorded one with a sentence added for the signature.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py rva:0xE21E0 (VA 0x4E21E0): the country arrives on the stack, not in ecx - `mov ebx, [ebp+8]` at 0x4E21FF, and every field is off ebx (+0xCA8, +0xCA4, +0x115C); ecx is never read before it is written. cfg.walk over the whole body finds exactly one return, `ret 4` at 0x4E39B9, so the callee cleans its one argument: __stdcall, the same shape project.json already records for CCountry::LoadOobFile. Call site 0x4A210F is a bare `push edi; call` with no `add esp` after it, and there are 65 callers. The return is void: the eax at the `ret` is whatever the preceding list-free loop left (`mov eax, esi` at 0x4E39A2), not a computed value. What would show it wrong: any caller doing `add esp, 4` after the call, which would make it __cdecl, or a caller that uses eax.

addresses.name: CCountry::GetDailyIncome
addresses.signature: CFixedPoint* __thiscall CCountry::GetDailyIncome(CCountry* this, CFixedPoint* out, int goodsCategory)
addresses.comment:
A day's income of one good: home_produced plus, for anything but supplies and fuel, convoyed_in, plus the five pools at +0x848, +0x8B4, +0x8FC, +0x9D4 and +0xA64. Each read as pool + 8 + category * 4.

**Signature**: `this` in ecx, out the hidden first stack argument and returned in eax, the goods category the second (`ret 8`).

Nothing else about the entry changes - the rva, the name, the kind and the confidence are as recorded, and the comment is the recorded one with a sentence added for the signature.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py rva:0xF1830 (VA 0x4F1830): the four are one shape and were read one by one. The receiver is ecx and is never copied - every pool is addressed as [ecx + category*4 + <pool offset>], and those offsets (+0x778, +0x79C, +0x7C0, +0x7E4, +0x82C, +0x850, +0x874, +0x8BC, +0x8E0, +0x904, +0x928, +0x994, +0x9B8, +0x9DC, +0xA6C) all lie inside CCountry's recorded pool block, +0x74C to +0xA64, each pool 0x24 apart with its first good at +8. [ebp+0xC] is the category and is used only as that scale, and is compared against 0 and 1 - supplies and fuel - in the income and the balance. [ebp+8] is the hidden out pointer: `mov eax, [ebp+8]`, the result stored as `mov [eax], ...`, and eax still holds it at the `ret`. cfg.walk: one `ret 8` in each of the four. Call site 0x4C792A pushes the category, then `lea edx, [ebp-0xC]; push edx; call`, with `mov ecx, ebx` before it; 0x6C9DB7 is `mov ecx, esi` with the out pointer pushed at 0x6C9DA6; both read the answer back as `[eax]`. What would show it wrong: a `ret` other than 8, or a caller that cleans the stack itself. The one naming choice rather than a reading is spelling the category `int`: it is one promoted dword holding the GoodsCategory enum (0 supplies, 1 fuel, 2 money, then the four resources), written as int so the arithmetic is checkable.

addresses.name: CCountry::GetAvailableIC
addresses.comment:
Spare industrial capacity: GetSpareICIn summed over the five ProductionCategory values from _PRODUCTION_CONSUMER_ to _PRODUCTION_UPGRADE_ - lend lease, category 0, is left out - and divided by 1000. So it is IC a slider has been given but does not need, not IC that is unallocated.

**Signature**: no arguments, `this` in ecx, a bare `ret`, and a plain int in eax.
addresses.revises: wave 3: the entry carried no signature at all, so CCountry::GetAvailableIC decompiled with an untyped receiver and every field access through it became an offset into nothing. Nothing else about the entry changes - the rva, the name, the kind and the confidence are as recorded, and the comment is the recorded one with a sentence added for the signature.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py rva:0xF4D70 (VA 0x4F4D70): `mov ebx, ecx` at 0x4F4D7E and ebx is pushed as the first stack argument of GetSpareICIn (0x4F4B90) at 0x4F4DBA, whose recorded signature already declares that parameter a CCountry* - so the receiver is settled by an entry not written here. No ebp+ read above the frame pointer; the 1..5 it loops over are written into its own frame at 0x4F4D80..0x4F4DA0. The sum is divided by 1000 (`imul 0x10624DD3; sar edx, 6`) and left in eax. cfg.walk: one bare `ret` at 0x4F4DDF. Call site 0x625A1E is `mov ecx, edi; call` with no push. What would show it wrong: a non-zero `ret` immediate, or a caller pushing an out pointer - none does; the int is the answer.

addresses.name: CCountry::GetPool
addresses.comment:
Answers the capital province's pool, or the country's own pool at +0x9F8 when the country is a government in exile (+0x95).

**Signature**: `this` in ecx, no stack arguments, a bare `ret` on both arms - the out-of-line body needs no register notation.
addresses.revises: wave 3: the entry carried no signature at all, so CCountry::GetPool decompiled with an untyped receiver and every field access through it became an offset into nothing. Nothing else about the entry changes - the rva, the name, the kind and the confidence are as recorded, and the comment is the recorded one with a sentence added for the signature.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py rva:0xF4DE0 (VA 0x4F4DE0): nine instructions. ecx is the receiver and is read directly - `cmp byte ptr [ecx+0x95], 0` is CCountry.use_own_pool, `lea eax, [ecx+0x9F8]` is CCountry.pool_in_exile (recorded type CGoodsPool), and the other arm calls 0x42F100 with ecx untouched and adds 0x15C, which project.json records as CMapProvince.pool, also a CGoodsPool - so both arms answer a CGoodsPool* and the return type is fixed by two independently recorded fields. The `push ecx`/`pop ecx` pair is a scratch slot, not an argument: nothing reads [esp] between them. cfg.walk: two returns, both bare `ret`. The call sites (0x4A2657 and ten others) set ecx and push nothing. What would show it wrong: a `ret N`, or CMapProvince +0x15C not being the pool. The copies inlined elsewhere are not evidence either way - this entry is only about the out-of-line body at 0x4F4DE0, and that one is an ordinary __thiscall.

addresses.name: CCountry::GetConvoyBuildCost
addresses.comment:
The CONVOY_BUILD_COST define (CDefines economy block, CONVOY_BUILD_COST) times (1000 + CTechnologyStatus 0x44) over 1000, floored at 10. Four functions of this one shape cover the convoy and escort cost and time.

**Signature**: `this` in ecx and the hidden out pointer the one stack argument (`ret 4`), returned in eax.
addresses.revises: wave 3: the entry carried no signature at all, so CCountry::GetConvoyBuildCost decompiled with an untyped receiver and every field access through it became an offset into nothing. Nothing else about the entry changes - the rva, the name, the kind and the confidence are as recorded, and the comment is the recorded one with a sentence added for the signature.
addresses.evidence: disasm.py rva:0xFD590 (VA 0x4FD590): the four are one shape, differing only in the define read and the CTechnologyStatus offset, and each was read separately. `mov esi, ecx` at the top and [esi+0xDF8] is the technology status the modifier comes from, so the receiver is the country; the define comes from GetDefines() (0x445D90), not from an argument. [ebp+8] is the only stack slot read: `mov edi, [ebp+8]`, the result stored through edi twice (the value, then the floor), and `mov eax, edi` returns it. cfg.walk: one `ret 4` in each of the four. Call site 0x41A9E2 is `push eax; mov ecx, esi; call 0x4FD600`; 0x549877 is `push ecx; mov ecx, edi; call 0x4FD6E0` - one push, ecx set separately, nothing cleaned by the caller. What would show it wrong: a `ret` other than 4, or a second ebp+ read in any of the four bodies.
